en.title: 10 Animated Gems You Can't Miss on Paramount+
en.summary: Paramount+ offers a surprisingly deep bench of animated series, from timeless classics to modern marvels. Dive into our curated list to find your next binge.
en.body:
## 1. Star Trek: Lower Decks
This hilarious deep-cut into the Starfleet support staff proves that even the grunts deserve their own adventures. Its pitch-perfect blend of Trek lore and workplace comedy, spearheaded by Mike McMahan, makes it essential viewing for any Trekkie who's ever wondered what happens on the less glamorous shifts aboard a starship.

## 2. SpongeBob SquarePants
The undisputed king of undersea silliness, SpongeBob continues to deliver pure, unadulterated joy. Created by the late Stephen Hillenburg, its enduring appeal lies in its surreal humor and surprisingly heartfelt moments, making it a comfort watch for generations.

## 3. Rugrats
This groundbreaking series gave us a toddler's-eye view of the world, filled with imaginative adventures and relatable family dynamics. The original run, which debuted in 1991, remains a cherished classic for its unique perspective and charm.

## 4. Transformers: EarthSpark
Reimagining the iconic robot franchise for a new generation, *EarthSpark* offers a fresh take on Autobot lore with compelling character development and exciting action. It deftly balances the familiar lore with new characters and stakes, making it a standout for both old and new fans.

## 5. The Fairly OddParents
Timmy Turner's wish-granting fairies, Cosmo and Wanda, have been a source of chaotic fun for years. Butch Hartman's creation masterfully blends fantasy with everyday childhood struggles, offering a consistently entertaining and imaginative ride.

## 6. Danny Phantom
This superhero origin story, created by Butch Hartman and Steve Marmel, follows a teen who becomes a ghost-human hybrid. Its stylish animation, compelling villain arcs, and relatable teenage angst cemented its status as a fan favorite.

## 7. Aaahh!!! Real Monsters
From Klasky Csupo, this series dives into the lives of young monsters attending a special academy. Its unique, grungy art style and inventive monster designs set it apart, offering a delightfully spooky and funny adventure.

## 8. The Legend of Korra
As a sequel to *Avatar: The Last Airbender*, Korra expands the world with a more mature narrative and complex themes. The series, co-created by Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko, dives deep into political intrigue and personal growth, offering a richer, more nuanced experience.

## 9. Pinky and the Brain
This Emmy-nominated series from Warner Bros. Animation features two lab mice with world-domination ambitions. The sheer comedic brilliance of its premise, coupled with the iconic catchphrases, makes it a timeless comedy classic.

## 10. Invader Zim
Despite its short original run, *Invader Zim* has achieved legendary cult status for its dark humor and distinctive animation style. Jhonen Vasquez's creation is a masterclass in biting satire and unforgettable character design, making it a must-watch for anyone who appreciates unconventional animation.
Bottom Line: Paramount+ is a surprisingly robust destination for animation enthusiasts, offering a diverse range of shows that cater to every taste and age group.

content_raw: Paramount+ boasts a pretty solid streaming catalogue in the realm of animation. Here are the 10 best animated shows currently streaming on the platform.
